import argparse
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as file:
        return hashlib.file_digest(file, "sha256").hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--reference", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--captures", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=("q5", "iq4", "q50", "iq4-xs"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--role", choices=("selected-f16", "original-f32"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=("raw", "chat", "both"), default="both")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.source / "tests"))
    from common import hf_depth_top1, HF_DEPTH_TOP1_MARGIN
    expected = {
        "iq4-xs": "dacc1fe1dc6f4799f366ac3385299f71c7e02c58b8702448a174f14d91b1c64d",
        "q50": "f4c47da009634e667ab016c9053b519500cf93290f1da989095fd32d711acf89",
        "q5": "10a55cebb3d4d17c89d570de9aab45cb5577584a2deb73cce9f60a5351ef4460",
        "iq4": "f1b14e28a6de64f21672ddf2c8f24736c389da4c64ebf024b1204f4f43a4fd71",
    }
    reference = json.loads((args.reference / "report.json").read_text())
    if args.variant == "both":
        assert reference.get("complete") is True, "Reference is not complete"
    assert reference["dtype"] == ("f16" if args.role == "selected-f16" else "f32")
    assert reference["reference"]["weights"]["sha256"] == expected[args.kind]
    capture = json.loads((args.captures / "report.json").read_text())
    assert capture["capture_complete"]
    report = {
        "kind": args.kind, "role": args.role, "model_sha256": expected[args.kind],
        "rule_owner": "tests/common.py:hf_depth_top1",
        "rule_source_sha256": sha(args.source / "tests/common.py"),
        "top_two_tie_margin": HF_DEPTH_TOP1_MARGIN,
        "reference_report_sha256": sha(args.reference / "report.json"),
        "capture_report_sha256": sha(args.captures / "report.json"),
        "runtime_source": capture["runtime_source"], "probe_sha256": capture["probe_sha256"],
        "variants_requested": args.variant,
        "scope": ("Selected-policy independent HF depth gate." if args.role == "selected-f16"
                  else "Same-file unrounded F32 HF companion; does not replace the selected-policy gate or measure original-checkpoint quantization quality."),
        "cells": [],
    }
    for variant in (("raw", "chat") if args.variant == "both" else (args.variant,)):
        source = args.reference / (variant + ".json")
        ref = json.loads(source.read_text())
        record = next(x for x in reference["cells"] if x["variant"] == variant)
        assert sha(source) == record["json_sha256"]
        assert ref["positions"] == list(range(16383, 16895))
        recorded = next(x for x in capture["depth_captures"]
                        if x["kind"] == args.kind and x["variant"] == variant)
        path = args.captures / (args.kind + "-" + variant + ".stdout")
        assert sha(path) == recorded["stdout_sha256"]
        assert recorded["matrix_paths"]["dtype"] == "f16"
        lines = [line.split() for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if re.match(r"^\d+ ", line)]
        assert len(lines) == 512
        rows = []
        for i, fields in enumerate(lines):
            assert len(fields) == 101 and int(fields[0]) == ref["positions"][i]
            actual = int(fields[1])
            ids, values = ref["top_ids"][i][:2], ref["top_logits"][i][:2]
            verdict, gap = hf_depth_top1(actual, ids, values)
            rows.append({"position": int(fields[0]), "actual_top1": actual,
                         "hf_top2_ids": ids, "hf_top2_logits": values,
                         "hf_gap": gap, "verdict": verdict})
        counts = Counter(row["verdict"] for row in rows)
        report["cells"].append({"variant": variant,
                                "counts": {key: counts[key] for key in ("exact", "accepted-tie", "miss")},
                                "matrix_paths": recorded["matrix_paths"], "rows": rows})
        print(args.kind, args.role, variant, dict(counts))
    report["no_misses"] = all(cell["counts"]["miss"] == 0 for cell in report["cells"])
    with args.output.open("x") as file:
        json.dump(report, file, indent=2)
        file.write("\n")
    return 0 if report["no_misses"] or args.role == "original-f32" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
